A '''helicite''' was a twisted [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] composed of [[gypsum]].<ref name="SotME" /> Helicites were found on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]<ref name="SotME" /> and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]' [[Color/Legends|graying]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] looked like gypsum helicites.<ref name="ANHn" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:OwenCardTrader.png|thumb|right|250px|Owen Lars' graying hair resembled gypsum helicites]]
Helicite was first mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="ANHn" /> It first appeared in the [[1978]] novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', also written by Foster.<ref name="SotME" />
